name: Workbooks Browser — open a workbook (app/MCP)
_note: Drives the REAL Tauri app via the embedded MCP (wb-aakl.11/.23). Requires the browser running with WB_MCP=1 (the socket /tmp/workbooks-mcp.sock must be live). The native/Linux screen recorder (record.sh, Phase 1) should place out/<take>.mp4 for the verifier; otherwise the harness builds a still-strip video from screenshots.
